items.title: Laguna de Bay
items.summary: Laguna de Bay, conveniently referred to as Laguna Lake, is the largest lake in the Philippines. Laguna de Bay is pronounced Laguna de bai, where the vowel “a” has a short sound, and was named after the town of Bay, in the province of Laguna during the Spanish colonial period.
